answer: In a decentralized AI economy, the use of digital signatures based on a voter-based mechanism, such as the "dawn" protocol, can effectively resist Sybil attacks. By requiring each agent to demonstrate its identity through a unique, one-time "onyx" token, malicious agents attempting to create multiple fake identities are penalized with a loss of "sable" tokens, thereby discouraging such behavior and maintaining the integrity of the network.
